_comment: Maps dataset headers to HEARTLAB model variables. Resolution order per variable: 'header' (exact, required if set) -> 'known_headers' (exact names of the configured dataset, used when present) -> 'patterns' (case-insensitive substrings). Units and definitions below are taken from the configured dataset's own headers and outcome_definition column.

heart_disease.label: CHD death rate
heart_disease.definition: Coronary heart disease mortality (ICD-9 410.0-414.9), age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. standard population, persons aged 35 and older, 1998

smoking.label: Current smoking
smoking.definition: Percentage of adults who currently smoke cigarettes, 1998

obesity.label: Obesity
obesity.definition: Percentage of adults with body mass index of 30 or higher, 1998

inactivity.label: No leisure-time exercise
inactivity.definition: Percentage of adults reporting no leisure-time physical activity or exercise, 1998

fruit_veg.label: Low fruit & vegetable intake
fruit_veg.definition: Percentage of adults eating fewer than five servings of fruit and vegetables per day, 1998. Higher values mean a worse diet, so a positive association is the plausible direction.

source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (published state-level tables)
source.provenance: Assembled from separate CDC-published state tables (file column source_status = 'assembled_from_separate_CDC_published_tables_not_original_CDCHeartRisk.xls'). It is not the original textbook spreadsheet CDCHeartRisk.xls, so results may differ from the textbook's.
source.year_note: Risk factors and the CHD mortality outcome are both 1998 in this file. The textbook (Section 14.3.6) dates its CDCHeartRisk.xls to 1999 and the companion handout to 1998; that discrepancy concerns the original spreadsheet, not this file.
